evidence.quote: the protein structure of the MANE transcript was retrieved from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database.

decisions.rationale: R1: the element names the database source from which protein structures were retrieved.

evidence.quote: The corresponding PDB files were first converted to graph  representations  using  Graphein

decisions.rationale: R7: graph construction from PDB files is stated, but no catalog operation represents this conversion.

evidence.quote: Structural  protein  embeddings  were  generated  using  a  Graph  Convolutional  Autoencoder (GCAE)

decisions.rationale: R3: a graph convolutional learned module is named, and convolution has no catalog operation.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.value: node embeddings within each protein structure are aggregated into one vector

evidence.quote: Node embeddings were subsequently aggregated by mean pooling, resulting in a single 128-dimensional embedding vector.

decisions.rationale: R6: mean pooling is represented by the add operation with mean-pooling scaling.

evidence.quote: To  obtain  compact  genomic  representations,  we  utilized  Evo2 22 7B,  a  large-scale  genomic foundation model trained on 9.3 trillion DNA base pairs.
For each gene's DNA sequence, pertoken embeddings were extracted from the 'blocks.28.mlp.l3' layer

decisions.rationale: R3: Evo2 is a named genomic foundation model that generates the DNA representations.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.value: token-level embeddings are aggregated along the sequence dimension for each gene

evidence.quote: These token-level embeddings were then aggregated using mean pooling along the sequence dimension, resulting in a fixed-size 4096-dimensional embedding vector for each gene.

decisions.rationale: R6: mean pooling is represented by the add operation with mean-pooling scaling.

evidence.quote: concatenated  and  prepended  to  the  textual  input  tokens
concatenated with a tokenized natural-language question

decisions.rationale: R6: tokenization of the natural-language question maps the symbolic text to input tokens.

evidence.quote: Amino acid sequence embeddings were generated using the ESMFold 36 (3B) model
embeddings from the last hidden layer of the ESM-2 block were extracted

decisions.rationale: R3: ESM-2 is a named pretrained protein language model that generates amino-acid representations.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.value: token-level embeddings are aggregated along the sequence dimension for each gene

evidence.quote: These  token-level embeddings were aggregated via mean pooling along the sequence dimension, resulting in a single 2,560-dimensional embedding vector per gene.

decisions.rationale: R6: mean pooling is represented by the add operation with mean-pooling scaling.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: PDB-to-graph conversion constructs graph nodes and relations rather than merely reshaping, partitioning, or aligning catalog data.
The documented graph-convolutional autoencoder computation is not represented by the generic projection or reshaping interfaces.
